note: Objectives, prerequisites and quiz alignment for the subject course. A lesson without objectives, a quiz item without an objective, or a cycle in the prerequisites is a curriculum defect (test_curriculum.py).

objectives.text: Distinguish chatbot, copilot and autonomous behaviour on one example
Explain why earned authority is reversible after a failed action
Place the deterministic decision inside a Code node, not in a prompt
Read a workflow receipt: input, decision, reasons
Describe what an actor run returns and what a snapshot keeps
Recognise when a source is not evidence (one voice, stale, or unreachable)

lessons.title: Tool permissions and the human exit

objectives.text: Write a least-privilege tool permission for one agent
Name the condition under which the agent must stop and ask a human
Explain how a chained receipt makes an action arguable after the fact
State the pre-registered condition that forces an undo
Separate a build-breaking metric from a nice-to-have metric
Design a trap fixture for the failure you fear most
Treat a hostile page as an input the system must refuse, not parse

downstream_rule: A change to a lesson marks every lesson whose prereq chain includes it as 'downstream to revisit' in the digest; the agent never rewrites downstream lessons in the same night (a human or the next scan decides).
